list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Tetranuclear gadolinium 1-(o-methoxyphenyl)-3,4-diphenylcyclopentadienyl chloride–potassium complex, THF trisolvate

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Fig. 1 and Table 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two dinuclear Gd2K chloride-bridged moieties are joined through K–Cl bonds in a planar K2Cl2 unit, giving a discrete Gd4K2 assembly. Each Gd is η5-bound to a cyclopentadienyl ligand and coordinated by THF and bridging chlorides; the methoxy oxygen does not coordinate to Gd.

synthesis.procedure: Under purified argon in anhydrous solvents, benzyl potassium was added slowly to the cyclopentadiene solution in THF and stirred for 15 min. The resulting cyclopentadienyl potassium solution was added slowly to stirred GdCl3(THF)2.1 in THF and stirred for 12 h.

reagents.name: benzyl potassium
reagents.role: base for in situ cyclopentadienyl potassium formation

synthesis.time: 15 min, then 12 h; crystals formed within 5 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: SPEKS-GB2 glove box; solution reaction under purified argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The reaction mixture was centrifuged, the solution concentrated to 10 mL, and hexane (20 mL) carefully layered without mixing. Crystalline I formed within 5 days and was dried under dynamic vacuum. X-ray-quality crystals were prepared by slow diffusion of hexane into a THF solution of I.

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Fig. 3 and Table 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A mononuclear bis(cyclopentadienyl) Gd complex in which Gd is η5-bound to two cyclopentadienyl ligands and coordinated by one chloride and the oxygen atoms of both methoxy groups. It crystallizes in the chiral space group P4₁2₁2.

synthesis.procedure: Under purified argon in anhydrous solvents, benzyl potassium was added slowly to the cyclopentadiene solution in THF and stirred for 15 min. The resulting cyclopentadienyl potassium solution was added slowly to stirred GdCl3(THF)2.1 in THF and stirred for 12 h.

reagents.name: benzyl potassium
reagents.role: base for in situ cyclopentadienyl potassium formation

synthesis.time: 15 min, then 12 h; crystals formed within 7 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: SPEKS-GB2 glove box; solution reaction under purified argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After centrifugation, the solution was concentrated to dryness and the oil triturated with hexane. The precipitate was isolated by centrifugation, dissolved in toluene (7 mL), and centrifuged to remove KCl. Hexane (30 mL) was carefully layered onto the solution. Crystalline II formed within 7 days and was dried under dynamic vacuum. X-ray-quality crystals were prepared by slow diffusion of hexane into a toluene solution of II.

title: Synthesis and Structural Diversity of Gadolinium 1-(o-Methoxyphenyl)-3,4-diphenylcyclopentadienyl Complexes
